Kuvitus: työpöydällä on puinen kaiutin,: Illustration: on a desk there is a wooden loudspeaker, from whose cone sound waves spread, and next to it a desk fan with turning blades. Nobody touches either, but the cone vibrates and the blades turn when electric current is switched on to the devices.
Kaksi periaatekuvaa, ei mittakaavassa. V: Two schematic figures, not to scale. On the left a wire is seen end-on between the poles of two magnets: the N pole is at the top and the S pole at the bottom, so the magnetic field points downwards. The current flows into the page in the wire, and the force of the magnetic field pushes the wire to the left, perpendicular to both the current and the field. On the right the right-hand rule: the thumb points in the direction of the current, the other fingers in the direction of the field (the obliquely drawn arrow comes towards the viewer), and the force points out of the palm, here downwards. The three arrows are perpendicular to each other.
Schematic figure seen from above, not to scale. The horizontal green field lines point to the right. The wire is at an angle alpha to the field, and the current flows along the wire towards the upper right. The component of the field perpendicular to the wire, B sin alpha, is drawn with a dashed line. The force points into the page, which is shown by a cross inside a circle at the middle of the wire.
Kaksi periaatekuvaa rinnakkaisista johti: Two schematic figures of parallel wires seen end-on, not to scale. On the left the current in both wires flows out of the page. The magnetic field of the left wire circles it anticlockwise, and at the right wire the field points upwards. The forces point from one wire towards the other: the wires attract each other. On the right the currents are in opposite directions, the current in the right wire flows into the page, and the forces point away from each other: the wires repel each other.
Kaksi periaatekuvaa tasavirtamoottorista: Two schematic figures of a direct-current motor, not to scale. On the left a current loop is seen along the axle between the N and S poles; the magnetic field points from left to right. In one side of the loop the current flows into the page and in the other out of the page. The forces on the sides are in opposite directions, one downwards and the other upwards, and they turn the loop anticlockwise. On the right the commutator: around the axle is a ring split into two parts, touched by two carbon brushes. The brushes are connected to the positive and negative terminals of the power supply.
Kaiuttimen poikkileikkaus, periaatekuva,: Cross-section of a loudspeaker, schematic figure, not to scale. On the left is an iron centre pole, and around it a ring magnet and a front plate. The centre pole is an N pole and the front plate an S pole, so in the narrow gap the magnetic field points radially outwards, upwards in the upper gap and downwards in the lower gap. In the gap is the voice coil: in the cross-section of its turns the current flows into the page above and out of the page below. On both sides the force points to the right, towards the cone, which is attached to the coil.
Kuvitus: kuulokkeet ja älypuhelin pöydäl: Illustration: headphones and a smartphone on a table. Each cup of the headphones contains a small loudspeaker, and sound waves spread from the cups.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: virtavaa'an lukem: Graph to scale: the change delta m in the reading of the current balance in grams as a function of the current I in amperes. Five data points at the currents 1.0; 2.0; 3.0; 4.0 and 5.0 A, with changes of 0.27; 0.64; 0.87; 1.24 and 1.47 g, and a line fitted to the points that passes through the origin and the grid point (5.0 A; 1.50 g) and continues as a dashed line after the last data point. The grid spacing is 0.5 A and 0.15 g.
